ss ourang medan mystery solved - SS Ourang Medan is one of the most chilling ghost ship mysteries in maritime history. In June 1947, a distress call was sent from the Malacca Strait stating 'All officers including captain are dead... I die.' When rescuers boarded the ship, they found the entire crew frozen in sheer terror with no physical injuries. Was it a chemical weapon leak, toxic gas, or a massive government cover-up?
